dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Shallow, broad U-shaped curve at the posterior boundary where the black fur meets the white lower back.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Large gap between pinnae, separated by the width of the cranial vault.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced contrast between the bright white fur of the head/upper back and the soiled, yellowish-brown hue of the fur on the lower posterior region.
